latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "Video Editing for Beginners YouTube" — AI-powered editing and export for YouTube videos, aimed at beginners.
- Upload raw clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB), describe your desired edits, and receive an edited 1080p MP4 ready to download.
- No software installation required; all rendering and processing happen on remote GPU servers.
- Simple session setup with automatic token generation for new users.
- Supports quick editing workflows, batch processing, and iterative refinements through an easy prompt-based interface.
- Fast, beginner-friendly: most video edits and exports complete in 1–2 minutes for short clips.
